targetText: The serf gives up, the proletarian receives.
summary: Comparing feudal serfdom and capitalist wage labor: serfs surrender part of their harvest, while proletarians receive a wage.
explanation: Engels contrasts the feudal and capitalist modes of production: the feudal serf possesses tools and land while surrendering produce or labor service directly to the lord, whereas the modern proletarian owns no means of production and receives a monetary wage.
